known.title: Exclude filesystem metadata from client-input detection

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a Mac user browses the prepared notes folder in Finder before supplying client notes.
The scan includes every file under `docs/context`, including Finder's `.DS_Store` metadata ([Apple documentation](https://support.apple.com/en-gw/102064)). Its binary contents survive decoding with `errors="replace"` and satisfy `line.strip()`, so `has_client_input` returns true with an untouched brief and no client note. `nextstep.signoff` then displays the seven questions prematurely. Exclude filesystem metadata and cover this case in the existing command-level regression test; its current Markdown-only inputs miss the defect.
findings.title: Exclude filesystem metadata from client-input detection

why: A salesperson or FDE with little Claude Code experience cannot start alone: nothing tells Claude how to set them up, guide them in plain words, or hand over to a developer, and forge next lists 7 sign-off questions before they have shared an idea.
